plate_comment: Percent peak torque x 256 (0x6400 = 100 percent) available at one engine speed, for the J1939 (Jcomm) engine configuration data of e2m block 10E2. param_1 is the engine speed (1/8 rpm), param_2 the friction fuel at that speed. It reads the fuel at 100 percent throttle (y = 400) at that speed from the maximum fuel grid (fuel_demand_threshold_interp_state, x axis fuel_demand_rpm_threshold_cal, y axis fuel_demand_rpm_limit_low_cal, grid fuel_demand_rpm_limit_high_cal), clamps it with cm848_clampFuelDemandToValidRange (0x1ec48), subtracts param_2 plus the coolant temperature friction correction throttle_demand_offset_cal_working, and divides by the peak fueling span j1939_peak_fueling_tau_0 (e2m 10DF +6 Jcomm_Pk_Fueling_Tau_0) minus j1939_friction_load_fueling_at_breakpoint_4 (10E2 +14) with cm848_signedDivisionWithSaturation. evidence: PGN proof in initFaultTimerMessage (0x1b900): j1939_pgn65251_tx_message.header.can_id is built from the constant 0xfee300 (PGN 65251), data_length = 0x1c = 28 and data_pointer = fault_timer_state_base; cm848_sendFaultTimerMessage (0x1b730) calls this function on that buffer and then sendJ1939Message(&j1939_pgn65251_tx_message). The 7 dwords it stores decode as the 28 bytes of Engine Configuration 1: SPN 188 / 539 (idle, point 1), 528 / 540, 529 / 541, 530 / 542, 531 / 543, 532 (high idle, point 6), 545 (0xffff), 544 (reference_engine_torque_working), 533 / 534 (ROM 0x5c39a and the time limit / 10 = 0.1 s per bit), 535 / 536 (/ 0x50 = 10 rpm per bit), 537 / 538; the local automotive DB table j1939_spns lists exactly these SPNs and resolutions for PGN 65251. It fills a buffer and sends nothing, so Payload, not Message. SHARED: faultTimerHandler is also CM550 0x3320e (function_renames.csv), so the main session holds this rename.
plate_comment: Fills the 28-byte payload of the J1939 engine configuration message, PGN 65251 (Engine Configuration 1), into the buffer param_1 (fault_timer_state_base; the transmit descriptor j1939_pgn65251_tx_message has its can_id built from 0xfee300 and length 28, set by initFaultTimerMessage at 0x1b900). First it refreshes the torque curve with governor_calculateIntegratorRpmOutput (0x507a20, the fault derate speed points) and cm848_updateProtectionStateMachine (0x20d10). Then, byte swapped to J1939 little endian, it stores: the speeds and percent torques of curve points 1-5 (e2m 1102 Jcomm_Determined_RPM_Point_1-5 at +16 / +12 / +18 / +1A / +14, SPN 188 / 528 / 529 / 530 / 531; the high byte of j1939_indicated_percent_torque_at_* plus 125, SPN 539 .. 543), the high idle speed of point 6 (engine_speed_limit_arbitration.lowest_source_speed_limit, or the droop corrected limit capped at 0xfaff, SPN 532), 0xffff for the endspeed governor gain (SPN 545), reference_engine_torque_working (1102 +1E, SPN 544), the maximum momentary override speed ROM 0x5c39a (e2m 10E7 +18 Jcomm_High_Idle_Override_Speed, SPN 533) and its time limit j1939_pgn61442_engine_overspeed_enable_time_limit / 10 (SPN 534), the speed control range limits governor_rpm_limit_cal / 80 and engine_speed_limit_maximum / 80 (10 rpm per bit, SPN 535 / 536) and the torque control range, 0 percent and the largest point torque (SPN 537 / 538). It sends nothing: cm848_sendFaultTimerMessage (0x1b730, registered for PGN 65251 in the periodic transmit queue) and cm848_processFaultMessageTiming (0x1b778, which resends when a value changed) call it and send the descriptor.

evidence: When algorithm_enable_flags_41_cal.reserved_bit_11 (guessed e2m Torque_Normalization_Enable; 31910 = 0x7ca6 in the dump, bit set) is set: j1939_reference_engine_fueling = (injection_quantity_combustion_chi_maximum - friction_fueling) x 10000 / ((fuel_demand_filter_dimension x 0x34f6) / reference_engine_torque_working). Reproduced from the RAM dump: (1030 - 397) x 10000 / ((290 x 13558) / 850) = 1368 = j1939_reference_engine_fueling (0x40ada6), while the ROM j1939_peak_fueling (0x5c348) reads 1501, so the computed branch is live. fuel_demand_filter_dimension is the lb-ft value of the e2m MT_Max_Torque_Map at the current engine speed (see 0x21ac0); 13558 / 10000 is 1.3558 N*m per lb-ft. Called by cm848_periodicTaskSet_sensorProcessing. No activation delay of any protection.
plate_comment: Recomputes the J1939 (Jcomm) reference engine fueling j1939_reference_engine_fueling (e2m 1102 +1C Jcomm_Reference_Engine_Fueling, 'Determined Peak Engine Fueling', MM3S) when bit 11 of algorithm_enable_flags_41_cal is set (guessed e2m Torque_Normalization_Enable; set in this calibration): (injection_quantity_combustion_chi_maximum - friction_fueling) x 10000 / ((fuel_demand_filter_dimension x 13558) / reference_engine_torque_working). fuel_demand_filter_dimension is the maximum torque in lb-ft at the current engine speed (e2m MT_Max_Torque_Map, cm848_calculateFuelDemandFilter at 0x29c98); x 13558 / 10000 turns it into N*m, so the net full load fuel is scaled by the reference engine torque (e2m 1102 +1E, 850 N*m) over that torque. RAM dump (key on, engine stopped): (1030 - 397) x 10000 / ((290 x 13558) / 850) = 1368 = j1939_reference_engine_fueling, against 1501 = j1939_peak_fueling (ROM, e2m 1104 +0) that cm848_initProtectionDelayDefaults (0x212dc) loads. Called from cm848_periodicTaskSet_sensorProcessing.

evidence: Sets actual_engine_percent_torque_times_256 (e2m 1102 +0 Jcomm_Actual_Engine_Ind_Torque): 0 when final_fueling equals fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal (e2m 10E7 +16 FSS_Zero_Torque_Fueling, 0 in ROM 0x5c398), else cm848_clampedDivisionWithBounds((final_fueling - zero) x 0x6400, j1939_reference_engine_fueling - zero, 32000, -32000) = percent x 256 clamped to plus or minus 125 percent. It is a ratio of fuelings, not a load rate of change.
plate_comment: Calculates the actual engine percent torque x 256, actual_engine_percent_torque_times_256 (e2m 1102 +0 Jcomm_Actual_Engine_Ind_Torque, 'calculated output torque of the engine'): 0 when final_fueling equals the zero torque fueling fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal (ROM 0x5c398, e2m 10E7 +16 FSS_Zero_Torque_Fueling), otherwise (final_fueling - zero) x 0x6400 / (j1939_reference_engine_fueling - zero), clamped to 32000 and -32000 (plus or minus 125 percent x 256) by cm848_clampedDivisionWithBounds. evidence: j1939_engine_percent_load_at_current_speed_times_256 (e2m 1102 +4 Jcomm_Ind_Percent_Load 'ratio of actual engine torque to max torque at current speed') = (final_fueling - fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal) x 0x6400 / (throttle_100_fueling - fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal) via cm848_saturatingDivision16, 0x8300 (-32000) when a difference is below -31999, capped at 32000. Its only caller cm848_buildPgn61443ElectronicEngineController2Message (0x25b10) sends the high byte as EEC2 byte 3 (j1939_eec2_percent_load_byte, SPN 92 percent load at current speed). The denominator is the 100 percent throttle (maximum) fuel curve at the current speed.
plate_comment: Calculates the engine percent load at current speed x 256, j1939_engine_percent_load_at_current_speed_times_256 (e2m 1102 +4 Jcomm_Ind_Percent_Load, 'ratio of actual engine torque to max torque at current speed'; SPN 92 of EEC2): (final_fueling - fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal) x 0x6400 / (throttle_100_fueling - fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal), i.e. the actual torque as a share of the torque of the 100 percent throttle fuel curve at the current speed (throttle_100_fueling, e2m 105A +0). The result is 0x8300 (-32000, minus 125 percent) when either fuel difference is below -31999 and is capped at 32000 (125 percent). Called by cm848_buildPgn61443ElectronicEngineController2Message (0x25b10), whose byte 3 is the high byte.

It receives no J1939 message. Wave 13 proposals taken as the literal form (bin 1) rather than the breakpoint form (bin 2), which omits point 5.
plate_comment: Sets points 2 and 5 of the J1939 (Jcomm) torque curve of the engine configuration message from one fueling on the engine speed limit droop line. The fueling arrives in r3 (decompiled as the pointer parameter rx_msg) and a flag in r4. The speed is the droop line speed at that fueling: engine_speed_limit_arbitrated + engine_speed_limit_droop_slope x (((engine_speed_limit_ramped_maximum_fuel_quantity - fueling) x 8) & 0xfff8) / 0x8888, capped at 40000 (5000 rpm), or torque_limit_working_reference when engine_speed_limit_droop_slope is 0. It stores that speed in j1939_torque_curve_speed_at_point_2 (e2m 1102 +24 Jcomm_RPM_At_Point_2, the high speed governor breakpoint) and in j1939_torque_curve_speed_at_point_5 (+2A; with r4 = 0 point 5 gets the ROM speed protection_threshold_base_cal instead, e2m 1104 +8 Jcomm_Engine_Speed_at_Point_5) and the fueling in j1939_torque_curve_fueling_at_point_2 (+2E) and j1939_torque_curve_fueling_at_point_5 (+34). Its only caller cm848_updateProtectionStateMachine (0x20d10) passes j1939_derated_fueling_at_point_4 with r4 = 1 when ROM 0x5c35e (e2m 1104 +16 Jcomm_Tau_0_Point_5_Intersection_Speed) is above the speed limit, otherwise j1939_derated_fueling_at_point_5 with r4 = 0. evidence: Builds the e2m 1102 torque curve of PGN 65251: a mode index (+4 governor_speed_limit_output outside the governor_output_t_0040aec2.idle_reference_speed +- low_speed_governor_reference_speed_delta band, +2 altitude or air fuel control derate in torque_derate_fuel_source_code, +1 engine_speed_limit_arbitration.limiting_source_number 1 / 2 / 4 / 5 / 12) picks the point speeds and fuelings from cm848_updateProtectionParameters (0x20b84), cm848_updateProtectionInputs (0x20bfc), cm848_processJ1939RxMessage (0x20c64) and the derated ROM values (e2m 1104 Jcomm_Derated_Fueling_*, Jcomm_Tau_0 / Tau_1_Derated_*); then j1939_indicated_percent_torque_at_idle_times_256 / _point_2_ / protection_speed_ratio_c / protection_speed_ratio_d / _point_5_ (1102 +8 .. +10) = cm848_clampedDivisionWithBounds((fueling - fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal) x 0x6400, governor_speed_ref_channel_a..e - zero, 32000, -32000), caches the determined speeds (+12 .. +1A) and Calc fuelings (+36 .. +3E), and resets the working fuelings to fuel_demand_maximum. No protection state machine. Called by faultTimerHandler (0x1b3a0) before the PGN 65251 payload is filled.
plate_comment: Builds the J1939 (Jcomm) engine configuration torque curve of PGN 65251, e2m block 1102: the speeds, fuelings and indicated percent torques at points 1-5. A mode index is formed from the situation: +4 when governor_speed_limit_output is outside the low speed governor idle band (governor_output_t_0040aec2.idle_reference_speed plus or minus low_speed_governor_reference_speed_delta), +2 for an altitude derate or an air fuel control derate with a fault in bits 8 / 9 of fault_detected_bits_0_to_15 (torque_derate_fuel_source_code), +1 when the engine speed limit source (engine_speed_limit_arbitration.limiting_source_number) is 1 / 2 / 4 / 5 / 12. Its cases load the point speeds and fuelings from the derated ROM values (e2m 1104 Jcomm_Engine_Speed_at_Point_3-5, Jcomm_Derated_Fueling_at_Idle-Point_5 and the tau 0 / tau 1 derated point 2, chosen by thermal_fuel_limit_factor) with cm848_updateProtectionParameters (0x20b84), cm848_updateProtectionInputs (0x20bfc) and cm848_processJ1939RxMessage (0x20c64). Each percent torque is (fueling at the point - fuel_demand_norm_zero_cal) x 0x6400 / (reference fueling at the point - zero) clamped to plus or minus 32000, with the reference fuelings governor_speed_ref_channel_a..e (+40 .. +48), into j1939_indicated_percent_torque_at_idle_times_256, _point_2_, protection_speed_ratio_c, protection_speed_ratio_d and _point_5_ (+8 .. +10). It caches the determined speeds (+12 .. +1A) and the calculated fuelings (Jcomm_Calc_Fueling_At_Point_1-5, +36 .. +3E) and then resets the working fuelings to fuel_demand_maximum, which cm848_updateProtectionDiagnostics (0x21cd4) lowers again. Called by faultTimerHandler (0x1b3a0) before each PGN 65251 payload is filled.

evidence: While algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal.programmable_power_enable is 0: j1939_reference_engine_fueling = j1939_peak_fueling (ROM, e2m 1104 +0 Jcomm_Peak_Fueling, 1501 in the ROM = 102.0 mm3) and reference_engine_torque_working = j1939_reference_engine_torque (1104 +2, 850 N*m). Called by initFaultTimerMessage (0x1b900), the PGN 65251 initialization; no protection delay is set.
plate_comment: Initializes the J1939 (Jcomm) reference values of the engine configuration message from the ROM: while the algorithm flag programmable_power_enable (algorithm_enable_flags_18_cal) is 0 it copies the peak fueling j1939_peak_fueling (e2m 1104 +0 Jcomm_Peak_Fueling, 1501 in the ROM = 102.0 mm3) into j1939_reference_engine_fueling (e2m 1102 +1C) and the reference engine torque j1939_reference_engine_torque (1104 +2 Jcomm_Reference_Engine_Torque, 850 N*m) into reference_engine_torque_working (1102 +1E). Called by initFaultTimerMessage (0x1b900), the PGN 65251 initialization; cm848_calculateProtectionActivationDelay (0x20500) recomputes the fueling afterwards when torque normalization is on.

evidence: Three cm848_dualAxisTableInterpolation calls over j1939_fuel_table_xaxis_cal (ROM 0x5c556 = e2m 140E MT_RPM_Axis), j1939_fuel_table_ystart_cal (0x5c582 = e2m 1447 MT_Alpha_Axis) and the grid j1939_fuel_table_yend_cal that follows it at 0x5c58e (the Z record e2m MT_Max_Torque_Map [FT*LB] names axes 140E:1447; its own block 1460 is not in the dumped ID table), at y = 0 and at y = chi map number x 0x4000 for the lower and upper chi maps, blended by cm848_interpolateAlphaChiValue like the maximum fuel curve. The ROM grid reads 385 .. 600 .. 589 .. 295 .. 0 over 800 .. 3500 rpm, a lb-ft curve peaking at 600, not fuel. With 0x34f6 = 13558 (1.3558 N*m per lb-ft) and 850 N*m the RAM dump reproduces 1368 in cm848_calculateProtectionActivationDelay (0x20500), where 290 is the twin cm848_calculateFuelDemandFilter (0x29c98) at speed 0. Maximum, by use: it is the full load torque paired with injection_quantity_combustion_chi_maximum in the engine_torque_estimate formula. Wave 13 read it as a fuel table because of the borrowed j1939_fuel_table_* names; no UDS service is involved.
plate_comment: Returns the maximum engine torque in lb-ft at the engine speed param_1 (1/8 rpm): the e2m MT_Max_Torque_Map (Table with max torque corresp. to MTTQMPXA values; engine speed axis 140E MT_RPM_Axis x alpha axis 1447 MT_Alpha_Axis, 600 lb-ft at its peak in the ROM grid). The ROM rows named j1939_fuel_table_xaxis_cal / j1939_fuel_table_ystart_cal / j1939_fuel_table_yend_cal (0x5c556 / 0x5c582 / 0x5c58e) are this torque map, not a fuel table. It looks the grid up with fresh cache words at the alpha 0 row and at the two chi map rows combustion_chi_lower_map_number / combustion_chi_upper_map_number (x 0x4000) and blends them with cm848_interpolateAlphaChiValue (0x14528) by the chi and alpha of combustion_reference_state, as cm848_lookupChiMaximumFuelAtSpeed (0x164e4) does for the maximum fuel. cm848_calculateFuelDemandFilter (0x29c98) does the same at the current engine speed into fuel_demand_filter_dimension. Called by cm848_updateProtectionDiagnostics (0x21cd4) with the five torque curve speeds.

evidence: protection_mode_request_bit = 1 << throttle_100_priority_bit_index (e2m 12BD +A). While programmable_power_enable is 0 it sets that bit in j1939_pgn65251_speed_points_request_flags, cm848_updateProtectionThresholdsIfLow (0x21c3c) writes the point speeds, and cm848_lookupChiMaximumFuelAtSpeed at the five point speeds gives the maximum fuels. Reference fuelings governor_speed_ref_channel_a..e (e2m 1102 +40 .. +48): j1939_reference_engine_fueling at every point when algorithm_enable_flags_41_cal bit 11 is clear, else maximum fuel / ((cm848_initUdsServiceHandlers(speed) x 0x34f6) / reference_engine_torque_working) - asm 0x21dd8-0x21dfc is bl 0x21ac0, mulli 13558, divw, divwu with no x 10000 and no friction term, unlike 0x20500. The divisor (torque x 13558) / 850 is 3939 for 247 lb-ft up to 9570 for 600 lb-ft over the grid below its last column (that column is 0, where the divisor would be 0), so fuels of 1030 .. 2082 counts (the chi maximum fuel range) give a quotient of 0; the dump (31910 = 0x7ca6 in algorithm_enable_flags_41_cal, bit 11 set) reads 0 in all five words. Fuelings (1102 +2C .. +34): when throttle_100_fueling_point_clamp_bitmap & cm848_getHighestPriorityBit() is non-zero the existing values are only lowered to the maximum fuel, else they are replaced by it unless a higher priority request bit is set (early return). Called by cm848_periodicTaskSet_diagnostics2.
plate_comment: Sets the fueling points of the J1939 (Jcomm) torque curve and the reference fuelings that scale them into percent torque, e2m block 1102, for the throttle 100 request of PGN 65251. plate_comment: Engine protection shutdown algorithm (e2m blocks 10B1 and 1152; enabled by bit 0 of governor_feature_config_word, e2m 106B +6 Engine_Protection_Shutdown_Enable, clear in this calibration: 15888 = 0x3e10 in the RAM dump): the last of the five tasks of cm848_runFaultDerateScheduler (0x507c44). With the engine STOPPED it clears governor_faultDerate_latch; with the shutdown disabled, or in SHUTDOWN or STOPPED, it clears engine_protection_shutdown_approaching_flag, the two shutdown time counts (fuel_temperature_derate_fuel_shutdown_time_count / _rpm_) and the override latch governor_fuel_derate_j1939_latch. Otherwise, unless the latch governor_faultDerate_latch is set, it goes through the channels whose shutdown enable bit is set (bit 130 + 4n of the e2m 106B +12 enable words): it counts the time over each of the channel's two thresholds (protection_event_timestamp, 0x508834; e2m 1152 +1A / +1C), keeps the longest in governor_faultDerate_peak_value, sets engine_protection_shutdown_approaching_flag (e2m 10B1 +14 Shutdown_Approaching) when a time passes its start warning time, and sets engine_shutdown_command_flag (10B1 +12 Shutdown, 'turn off all solenoids') when it passes the warning time plus the channel's shutdown delay, recording the channel in governor_faultDerate_active_channel. An override request (the latch governor_fuel_derate_j1939_latch) sets the time back to the warning time and starts the override lamp flag at 0x40a78b (e2m 10B1 +19 EPF_Shutdown_Override_Lamp_Flag). The restart results engine_protection_precrank_shutdown_command_flag and governor_faultDerate_engine_sync_trigger (10B1 +0 Restart_Oil_Pressure_Shutdown) also force the shutdown. Each shutdown increments governor_faultDerate_total_event_count and, for the same channel, governor_faultDerate_consecutive_count, and is held in governor_faultDerate_latch. It ends by setting governor_fuel_derate_state (e2m 10B1 +1E J1939_EP_Timer_State): 3 when the shutdown is disabled, 1 while a timer runs or the approach flag is set, otherwise 0.
